description: This Java class, CumulativeDecliningBalanceInterestLoanScheduleGenerator, is part of a loan scheduling system within the Apache Fineract project. It extends an abstract class to generate loan repayment schedules using a cumulative declining balance interest method, supporting different amortization schemes such as equal principal payments and equal installments. The class includes methods for calculating principal and interest components per repayment period, taking into account interest rate variations, interest compounding, grace periods, and other loan terms.

classes.name: CumulativeDecliningBalanceInterestLoanScheduleGenerator
classes.description: A Spring component class responsible for generating loan repayment schedules based on the cumulative declining balance interest method, supporting complex interest calculations with variations over periods and grace handling.

methods.name: getScheduledDateGenerator
methods.description: Returns the scheduled date generator used for determining payment dates.

methods.name: getPaymentPeriodsInOneYearCalculator
methods.description: Returns the calculator for determining number of payment periods per year.

methods.name: calculatePrincipalInterestComponentsForPeriod
methods.description: Main method that calculates principal and interest components for a specific period, considering interest rate variations, compounding, grace periods, principal variation, and other loan terms.
